bindings.requestId: Every response carries the initiating requestId; both peers reject a mismatch and the desktop refuses a replayed id.
bindings.origin: The totp request carries one normalized page origin. The desktop offers only logins saved at that origin or its www alias, and every release rechecks under the vault lock after a fresh approval for that exact origin.
bindings.code: A derived code only, never the seed. The desktop computes it after approval and zeroizes it on drop; it is never written to the pending request, diagnostics, or the clipboard.
bindings.expiry: Not transmitted as caller-controlled data. The desktop owns the 30-second deadline and rechecks the pending request, connection, vault session epoch, and deadline before release.
